s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive, ulcerative, purpuric skin lesion with multifocal peripheral patches, papules, and macules
salient_findings: Enlarging purpuric patch on the left lateral superior forehead and left anterior scalp
Central ulceration and bleeding of the lesion
Multifocal peripheral reddish-purple patches, papules, and macules
key_facts: Lesion first developed in March 2014
Rapid growth and extension of the lesion in June 2014
Lesion size: 30 × 25-cm
Location of the lesion: left anterior scalp, left parietal scalp, left forehead, left lateral cheek, right frontal scalp, and right parietal scalp
No evidence of lymphadenopathy
Dermis permeated by irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes
Cells had pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei
Cells stained positively with CD31 and were negative for CK5
Strong immunopositivity for ADRB1, ADRB2, and ADRB3 receptors

shortlist.label: angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: aggressive skin lesion with rapid growth and ulceration

shortlist.label: vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: purpuric patches and papules with inflammation of blood vessels

shortlist.label: skin cancer
shortlist.why_kept: ulcerative skin lesion with potential for malignancy

shortlist.label: dermatitis
shortlist.why_kept: inflammatory skin condition with potential for purpuric lesions

shortlist.label: eczema
shortlist.why_kept: chronic inflammatory skin condition with potential for skin lesions

raw.rationale: The presence of irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes in the dermis, cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei, and strong immunopositivity for CD31 and ADRB receptors are characteristic features of angiosarcoma.

rejected.label: vasculitis
rejected.why: Vasculitis typically presents with inflammation and damage to blood vessels, but the biopsy findings do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: skin cancer
rejected.why: While skin cancer is a broad term, the specific features of this case, such as the presence of erythrocytes in slitlike spaces, are more suggestive of angiosarcoma.

rejected.label: dermatitis
rejected.why: Dermatitis is an inflammatory condition of the skin, but the biopsy findings and clinical presentation do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: eczema
rejected.why: Eczema is a type of dermatitis, and the clinical and biopsy findings do not support this diagnosis.
